$comment: Version-pinned registry vocabulary for at.opake.* records. Single source of truth, consumed by opake-core (Rust, compile time) and the indexer (Elixir, boot). Governed by openspec/specs/record-validity: vocabulary is cumulative (version N permits every value pinned at or below N); introducing a new value is a version bump; extending the field list is itself a version bump. Structural discriminants ($type tags) are NOT vocabulary. See docs/CRYPTO.md and lexicons/README.md.

keyWrapAlgo.$comment: wrappedKey.algo, on grants, directories (keyWrapping), keyrings, and pair responses.

contentEncryptionAlgo.$comment: encryption envelope algo, on documents and keyrings.

publicKeySignatureAlgo.$comment: Pre-v1 verified-accounts redefinition of version 1; no compatibility shim. at.opake.publicKey signatureAlgo.
